title: FLAT HUD PANELS, SHORTER DEMO CARD
why: The critic on the raid screen (10-19): panels have a gradient wash and a faint border; the demo gun card has an empty strip over the name. The style guide: Panel P has no gradient, a 1px line.
now: HUD panels are flat with a clearer 1px edge and the demo gun card is shorter.

edits.anchor: try{ g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,y,0,y+h); g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(24,27,30,'+a+')'); g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(14,16,18,'+a+')'); ctx.fillStyle=g; }catch(_g){ ctx.fillStyle='rgba(17,19,21,'+a+')'; }
edits.replacement: ctx.fillStyle='rgba(17,19,21,'+a+')';   // v28.xx (cw-panelflat), the critic (2026-10-19) and the style guide (Panel P: 'NO gradient'): one flat fill, was a top-to-bottom wash
ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(112,122,130,.95)'; ctx.lineWidth=1; ctx.stroke();   // v28.xx (cw-panelflat): the 1px line is lighter so the edge reads (the critic: 'no 1px border')
var _gtop=trDemo()?LH(62):LH(90), _gh=trDemo()?LH(58):LH(100);   /* v28.xx (cw-panelflat), the critic (2026-10-19): the demo card had dead space over the name; it is 58 high, the top moves down 14 */
